meta.title: Lilian Mesquita | English and communication for executives
meta.description: I prepare executives, lawyers, doctors and business owners for meetings, negotiations, interviews and talks in English, with the Inductive Method.
meta.og_description: I don't prepare you for the classroom. I prepare you for the room you're about to walk into.

hero.title: I don't prepare you for the classroom. I prepare you for *the room you're about to walk into.*
hero.lead: A meeting, a negotiation, an interview, a stage. For professionals with an international commitment on the calendar who need to arrive ready for it.
hero.note: Online sessions, in Brazil and abroad.
hero.photo_alt: Lilian Mesquita in a purple blazer, seated in her office

question.title: “Is my English good enough?”
question.body: Almost every executive asks me this in our first conversation. The right question is a different one: good enough for what? For which room, with whom on the other side, on what date?
question.thesis: Your English isn't behind. *Your idea is.*
question.thesis_note: Communication isn't measured when it leaves you. It's measured when it arrives. If the message isn't clear in your own language, it won't arrive whole in English.

trap.title: The more you study like a student, the more you wait to be corrected.
trap.body: And students don't negotiate, lead or give talks. Reading, taking notes and reviewing feel like progress. Confidence comes from speaking, recording and rehearsing the real situation.
trap.punch: You're not a student. *You're a speaker.*

method.title: The path has four steps.
method.intro: Every process starts from your scene, not from grammar. The four steps work together: remove one and the whole result weakens.

pillars.name: Scene
pillars.text: The date, the room, who decides on the other side and what's at stake: the role, the contract, the position.

pillars.name: Essence
pillars.text: The idea organized before it becomes English. The same authority in both languages, without the emotional block.

pillars.name: Niche
pillars.text: The language of your world: law, medicine, negotiation, trade. What you won't use stays out.

pillars.name: Action
pillars.text: The scene rehearsed until it becomes memory, with short daily practice and feedback. No reading, no note-taking.

method.layer: Across every step: body, voice and emotion. Posture, diction and presence.
method.close: Opening night is never the first time.

audience.title: For people with an important room ahead of them.
scenes: Meetings or negotiations with international partners
audience.not_for: It's not for anyone looking for one-off lessons or a course without a goal. I work in processes with a beginning, a middle and an end, built around a real commitment.

steps.name: Application
steps.text: Tell me about your scene and its date. It takes about 2 minutes.

steps.name: Business Analysis
steps.text: A conversation with me about the commitment, what's at stake and the right format for you.

steps.name: Scene Map
steps.text: Together we map the room, the people and the situations you'll face.

steps.name: Weekly rehearsal
steps.text: From 1 to 5 online sessions a week, short daily practice with feedback, and group practice.

steps.name: Opening night
steps.text: A full final simulation. When the day comes, the scene is already familiar.

cases.title: I studied the scene before they did.

items.name: Isabella Witzel
items.text: She already communicated in English, but in that room she would need to argue and persuade. In 45 days, every topic of the course became a real situation: BATNA, ZOPA, anchoring, active listening. When she sat at the table with an American judge, Arab heirs and leading lawyers, no topic was new.
items.after: Afterwards, we built her talk on negotiation for lawyers together.

items.tag: University of Akron and SDA Bocconi
items.name: Vinícius Vilela
items.text: First, English to travel without freezing. With that foundation, he was accepted into the University of Akron executive program, among about 7,000 applicants. Then he came back with a new scene, Milan: 24 sessions designed around the Bocconi program. He was accepted with a scholarship.
items.after: When someone comes back for a new goal, the method has been proven in practice.

others.title: Machine Learning Engineer
others.text: He had to defend his thesis before an international panel, and English was his biggest barrier. In 4 months, we reached the goal. Today English is just one more tool he masters and uses when he needs it.

others.title: Ana
others.subtitle: Trade Marketing Coordinator
others.text: She had already missed several chances of promotion to manager. Her communication blocks and her English kept her from competing for the role. Today she leads bilingual meetings with confidence and ease.

others.title: Robson
others.subtitle: Plant Manager
others.quote: I went up to speak at a company event for 400 employees and froze with the microphone in my hand. After 3 minutes of silence, I walked out of the auditorium. I had no idea what to say or do. I thought I could improvise, but it didn't work.
others.text: Today he leads international meetings and speaks to his teams with authority and confidence.

cases.more: I have also prepared many executives for international trade fairs and business in China, the USA and Europe, among other destinations.

about.title: I used to hate English. *My struggle became the method.*
about.story: I failed English in college. I kept only what I needed to communicate and trained my own way. In less than three months, I was the only one in a class of 45 speaking English with the professors. Today I prepare professionals for the most important rooms of their careers.

form.no_sem_data: Right now, my work is preparing professionals for a commitment with *a set scene and date*. The date gives direction to every session, to the vocabulary and to the rehearsal. When your meeting, interview, trip or stage has a date, come back. I'll be glad to read your application.
form.no_sem_rotina: The method's results come from constant rehearsal: weekly sessions and a short practice every day. If that doesn't fit your routine right now, the process wouldn't have the strength it needs. When there's room in your schedule, come back.
form.no_sem_formato: What I offer is an individual process, with a beginning, a middle and an end, built around your scene. I don't offer one-off lessons. If you ever have an important commitment ahead and want to truly prepare for it, come back.
form.no_follow: In the meantime, I share how I work on communication on Instagram.
